review_kind: Exact structural diff review by package preparer; not an external review or formal verification of the mathematics.
method: Parse originals and publication copies into Python ASTs. Replace every original Assert(test,msg) with If(Not(test), Raise(AssertionError(msg))), supplying a neutral diagnostic only when msg was absent. Compare complete ASTs without source locations.
semantic_scope: In normal Python mode, each test and diagnostic expression is preserved and evaluated with the same conditional timing. Under -O the publication copies intentionally retain those checks instead of dropping them.
